html:
Hassanal Bolkiah has been sultan of Brunei since 1967, one of the longest reigning monarchs in the world. Brunei became fully independent under him on 1 January 1984.

He is also prime minister, defence minister and finance minister, ruling under the emergency powers in force since the 1962 revolt. Oil and gas wealth made him one of the richest people on Earth.

Brunei joined the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN) in 1984. He has pushed the national idea of a Malay Islamic Monarchy and introduced sharia criminal law. He descends from Muhammad Shah, the first sultan.
